sources.label: ChromeStatus feature 5515971464527872 — Expose unprintable areas via CSS

inventory.name: page-margin-safety-top/right/bottom/left environment variables (read via env(), e.g. env(page-margin-safety-top))

outputs.rationale: CSS environment variables are declarative read-only values; they produce no programmatic return value to a caller.

errors.rationale: CSS declarations do not throw exceptions; an unavailable environment variable resolves to its fallback or is ignored.

lifecycle.rationale: Environment variables are declarative styling values with no explicit construction, mutation, or teardown lifecycle.

securityPrivacy.rationale: The page does not document security or privacy implications of exposing device-specific printer hardware margins.

notes: Added ids to headings: why-it-exists, syntax, examples, browser-support, and see-also. The four variables are inventoried as one css-family item because the page documents them as a single table. securityPrivacy is marked not-applicable because the page carries no security/privacy content; printer hardware margins are device-specific and could merit a privacy note, but none is documented.
